Sandeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 15
February, 2024

Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:13731
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9672 of 2023

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Sandeep Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ashok Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. This is the second bail application.
The first bail application was rejected by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court as not pressed vide order dated 20.10.2022.

3. The counsel for the applicant argues that in terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant around one year ago, subsequently on 12.06.2020 she died.

The post mortem report on record indicates the cause of death is ante mortem hanging and apart from ligature mark, three contusion injuries were seen on the back of the head in the right Sandeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

entities.text: Sandeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further argues that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 15.06.2020, as such, he may be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that the applicant is in custody since 15.06.2020 and there is nothing on record to suggest that soon before the death, the deceased was subjected to any mental and physical harassment in relation to the demand of dowry and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Sandeep Kumar be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 421 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Gola, District Kheri, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.2.2024 Arun  Sandeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173207250/
